baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of appearance, bad aspects, and intentional work at focus words 1, 3, and 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: A deed can remain familiar while its bad quality is concealed or misrecognized. The verse first removes that concealment, so intentional acts become present to their agents under the ugly or injurious aspect those agents had not granted them.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from concealment supplies the transition from an already existing deed to its now exposed quality.
Moral ugliness and defect specify what becomes perceptible in the agents' work.
Purposive action makes the disclosed badness the quality of their own intended conduct, not an unrelated spectacle.

changed_reading.before: Bad things they did simply become visible.
changed_reading.after: Their familiar, intended deeds are re-presented in the bad quality that had been hidden or refused.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The appearance is explicitly to them, and it is coupled with the badness of what they did.
baseline_models.mechanism: The appearance root also permits the arising of a new opinion. The scene can therefore register an involuntary change of judgment: conduct once normalized or mocked away now dawns on its agents as blameworthy.

activation_trace.role: A newly arising appraisal turns objective visibility into a forced revision of the agents' own judgment.
The branch of exposing fault supplies the evaluative content of the new appraisal.
Intentional conduct anchors the changed opinion in what they themselves chose to do.

changed_reading.before: Previously unseen objects are shown to them.
changed_reading.after: What changes is also their reading of their own conduct: its fault becomes undeniable to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins an enclosing descent at word 6 to the object of habitual ridicule at word 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ridicule creates discursive distance by treating its object as weightless or unreal. Descent and enclosure reverse that relation: the dismissed object acquires spatial agency and determines the ridiculers' entire situation.

activation_trace.role: A harmful reality both lands upon and surrounds them, converting an attitude into an encompassing consequence.
Mockery supplies the prior distancing relation that enclosure overturns.
Past, sustained occurrence gives the ridicule duration, allowing a former stance to become a present environment.

changed_reading.before: Punishment arrives for something they used to mock.
changed_reading.after: The very reality held at a mocking distance returns with agency, lands on them, and closes the surrounding space.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier threat is positioned on the concealed or far side of the addressees while their acquisitions cannot protect them. The focus then changes that unseen beyond into visible enclosure: what was outside their operative horizon is suddenly all around them.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the transition from hidden placement to present visibility.
Landing and enclosure complete the spatial reversal from beyond them to around them.
Concealment on the other side supplies a threat that is real while screened from present view.
Acquired benefit is rendered unable to shield its acquirers from the concealed threat.

structural_cues: 45:10 places the threat in a relative position outside ordinary view and immediately denies protective force to acquisitions.
45:33 coordinates disclosure with a verb of landing and enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed relative placement, failed acquisitions, disclosure, and enclosure; I infer a spatial movement from beyond awareness to total surround. The earlier relative term can alternatively be temporal, so the movement need not be literal geometry.

changed_reading.before: A previously hidden punishment becomes visible.
changed_reading.after: A threat kept beyond their working horizon crosses that boundary and becomes the space containing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly links recompense to acquisition, locates harmful action upon the acting self, promises return, and describes bad acts as things actively procured. The focus can thus be read as a reflexive economy in which purposive outputs return as the agents' own harmful surroundings.

activation_trace.role: An injurious outcome allows the bad aspects to be both moral qualities and what now harms their producers.
Purposive work identifies the originating human contribution to the returning consequence.
The return becomes environmental when the harmful result lands and encloses.
A response corresponding to an act supplies the context's reciprocal accounting rule.
Active acquisition makes conduct something accumulated by its agent rather than an event that vanishes.
The person's own identity is the destination upon or for which the action operates.
Return supplies the trajectory by which prior conduct can confront its source.
The image of actively procuring a deed intensifies agency behind the bad acts repeated near the focus.
Corresponding recompense states the proportional return that the focus renders as disclosure and enclosure.
What each person acquires supplies the retained material on which recompense operates.

structural_cues: 45:15 directs beneficial action for the self and harmful action upon it, then closes with return.
45:21 repeats bad acts and work in a contrast between two ways of living, while 45:22 denies injustice in individual recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposive action, acquisition, self-direction, return, and corresponding recompense; I infer that deeds persist into the conditions that meet their agents. A live alternative is that an external judge imposes a separate but exactly matched result.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds are displayed and a separate punishment surrounds them.
changed_reading.after: What they intentionally accumulated returns upon the self, so displayed deed and enclosing consequence can be two phases of one reflexive process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes acoustic reception from responsive understanding, then depicts persistence, a secured seal, and a visual cover despite plainly disclosed signs. Appearance to them in the focus is therefore not merely new data; it can be the forced collapse of a maintained perceptual regime.

activation_trace.role: A new appraisal captures the internal reversal produced when prior occlusion fails.
Recognition of fault is the evaluative perception that the failed occlusion had deferred.
Understanding and responsive compliance expose the gap between receiving sound and allowing it to change conduct.
Resolved persistence supplies the active maintenance of the resistant reading.
A secured barrier models closure against incoming correction.
Ordinary seeing identifies the faculty whose obstruction the later appearance reverses.
An overlying screen supplies the layer that keeps an available reality from being seen.
Prior manifestness shows that later disclosure need not mean the evidence was formerly absent.

structural_cues: 45:8 juxtaposes hearing recitation with acting as though no hearing occurred.
45:23 distributes closure across hearing, inner response, and sight, while 45:25 calls the recited signs plain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies available signs, resisted uptake, sealed access, visual covering, and later appearance; I infer continuity between the earlier resistant perception and the focus's forced recognition. The seal may alternatively be an imposed consequence rather than a self-maintained mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus reveals facts that had not previously been available.
changed_reading.after: Already available evidence finally defeats a resistant way of seeing, forcing a new judgment of their deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each community is summoned to a register, the register indicates against them in truth, and their work has been copied into it. The focus disclosure can therefore be an evidentiary re-presentation: actions do not first come into being there but become legible as recorded, charge-bearing facts.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from concealment describes the record's evidence becoming inspectable.
Exposure of fault gives the appearing evidence its accusatory force.
Intentional acts are the source material that the record preserves and re-presents.
Entry into a register gives each summoned community an indexed evidentiary relation to its deeds.
Corresponding recompense makes the register operational rather than merely archival.
Self-indicating evidence lets the preserved work function as testimony against its agents.
Demonstration of what is real supplies the record's truth-bearing force.
Transfer into a written copy explains how transient acts remain available for later disclosure.
The copied content is explicitly purposive conduct, tying the evidentiary mechanism back to the focus anchor.

structural_cues: 45:28 moves from collective summons to present recompense for prior work.
45:29 gives the register a speaking function and directly links its copying process to what they had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies summons, register, truthful indication, copying, and work; I infer that the record mediates the focus's appearance of bad deeds. The live alternative is that the record only witnesses a disclosure produced by another mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Their bad deeds suddenly appear as remembered past events.
changed_reading.after: Their acts are preserved, indexed, and made to testify, so appearance is forensic replay with present force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier and later repetitions identify signs as a chosen object of ridicule, while the promised appointment is treated as uncertain and worldly appearance deceives. Denial of exit after the focus then makes enclosure concrete: ridicule's strategy of unreality and distance terminates in a condition that cannot be left.

activation_trace.role: Harmful landing and enclosure convert the denied referent into the agents' unavoidable condition.
Ridicule is the distancing stance whose object the context progressively identifies.
The earlier occurrence attaches ridicule specifically to encountered signs rather than to an unspecified joke.
An appointment fixed to a time or place gives the denied future event a determinate point of arrival.
The later causal repetition confirms sign-ridicule as a direct antecedent of the enclosing condition.
Deception by an attractive but unstable appearance explains how the ridiculers maintained the false distance.
Blocked passage to the outside turns the focus's enclosure into a sustained no-exit state.

structural_cues: 45:9 and 45:35 place ridicule in direct relation to the signs, while 45:32 centers doubt on the promised Hour.
45:35 follows the focus with denied removal and denied restoration; the latter cue has no branch inventory and is used structurally only.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sign-ridicule, a fixed appointment, deceptive worldly appearance, and denied exit; I infer that mockery manufactured imaginary distance which arrival and enclosure reverse. The mocked object can still be broader than the signs or Hour and include the whole threatened reckoning.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified object of joking becomes the reason for punishment.
changed_reading.after: The signs and promised encounter they deliberately made unreal become an arrived, enclosing reality with no outward passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Habitual mockery in the focus is temporally conserved until an appointed encounter. The next verse's reciprocal neglect turns their prior abandonment of that meeting into an abandonment they undergo, so the enclosing consequence is also a social and temporal reversal.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence across past time gives the mocking stance a duration whose consequence can be deferred.
Sustained ridicule is the prior relational act later answered in reverse.
Arrival and surround mark the point at which the deferred relation becomes present experience.
A temporally or spatially fixed appointment prevents postponement from canceling the encounter.
A bounded span of time connects the formerly neglected meeting with the now-present day.
Leaving and neglecting operate on both sides of the comparison, producing enacted reciprocity.
Two sides coming face to face turns the formerly dismissed future into direct confrontation.

structural_cues: 45:32 voices uncertainty about the appointed Hour immediately before the focus.
45:34 uses a matched neglect construction and names the meeting with the present day immediately after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies habitual past mockery, appointment, day, reciprocal neglect, and encounter; I infer that the earlier stance is retained until it returns as the relation they experience. The alternative is that reciprocal neglect is a separate consequence rather than the internal mechanism of enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Past mockery is background conduct followed later by punishment.
changed_reading.after: The neglected encounter preserves their past stance across time and returns it relationally: those who abandoned the meeting are themselves left within it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the appearance root rather than its surface sense. It remains anchored by the focus's appearance-plus-enclosure sequence and by the following denial of outward passage. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root activation: disclosure feels inseparable and inescapable, not as a lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus binds appearance at word 1 to enclosure at word 6, and the next ayah denies removal from the resulting state.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapping contributes an image of necessary attachment with no separation, recasting disclosure as something that cannot be escaped.
Surrounding harm gives the split-root inescapability a direct spatial anchor in the focus.
Passage to an outside would break enclosure; its explicit denial supports the contained no-separation activation.

changed_reading.before: Disclosure is a moment of seeing followed by a separate confinement.
changed_reading.after: The disclosure itself becomes inseparable from them: what appears is also what they cannot part from or exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because severe cold is a remote material branch for both the persistence and ridicule roots, not their surface meanings here. It remains worth carrying because the same thermal image recurs across the resistant stance and the focus lexeme, while the focus explicitly supplies harmful impact and enclosure. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy of hardening and biting return, never a claim that the verse literally denotes weather.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes the object associated with ridicule at word 11 land upon and surround the ridiculers at word 6.

activation_trace.role: A branch of extreme temperature materializes obstinate persistence as a hardened, contracting condition.

changed_reading.before: Persistent mockery is an attitude later met by punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the stance hardens like extreme cold and returns through the mocked root as a biting condition that strikes and surrounds.

strongest_changes: Acquisition, self-direction, return, and corresponding recompense turn displayed badness into a reflexive economy of deeds becoming conditions for their agents.
The summoned, copied, truth-bearing register recasts appearance as evidentiary replay rather than sudden creation.
Repeated sign-ridicule, a fixed encounter, deceptive appearance, and denied exit identify the mocked reality and convert imagined distance into enclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserves simultaneous moral, perceptual, forensic, spatial, temporal, and reciprocal readings. It also retains, with explicit containment, the non-dominant split-root image of inseparability and a shared temperature image linking hardened persistence to a striking return.
remaining_uncertainties: The bad aspects may denote the deeds themselves, their harmful consequences, or a deliberate overlap of both.
The mocked referent may be specifically the signs and promised Hour or the whole threatened reckoning.
Appearance may foreground objective disclosure, forced subjective reappraisal, or both at once.
The split-root and temperature outliers are live activations, not claims about surface lexical sense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hidden acts become the visible environment.** `ب د و/B001` is emergence after concealment, `س و ء/B001` harmful ugliness, and `ح ي ق/B001` harm descending and surrounding. The two clauses move from deeds appearing before them to mocked reality closing around them. The packet supplies this spatial reversal; I infer that disclosure changes object into environment. What had been held at observational distance now determines the observers' available space.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 45:34-35 specify the enclosure produced here: forgotten encounter is reciprocated, fire becomes the resort, and neither exit nor appeasement remains.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Works become their own visible evidence.** Lexical anchors: visible emergence in `ب د و B001`, badness in `س و ء B001`, harm in `س و ء B002`, and intentional work in `ع م ل B001`. The packet supplies the book's speech-like indication in 45:29 and the professed uncertainty of 45:32. I infer preserved work -> visible emergence -> correction of claimed uncertainty. `بَدَا لَهُمْ` makes judgment perceptual: what had been treated as absent or speculative appears from their own activity rather than arriving as foreign information.
2. **What mockery held at a distance changes into surrounding harm.** Lexical anchors: harm coming down and surrounding in the sole `ح ي ق B001` branch, and mockery in `ه ز ء B001`. The packet supplies the gathered judgment scene in 45:28, then shelter in fire and no exit in 45:34-35. I infer derided object kept conceptually outside -> consequence descends -> mocker enclosed. The ayah's surprise is spatial reversal: ridicule no longer controls distance once its object becomes the subject's environment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:34-35 turned surrounding harm into a complete spatial mechanism: it becomes an anti-shelter from which there is no exit. That later enclosure sharpened `ح ي ق B001` from harm merely arriving to harm replacing the mocker's environment.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir binek hayvanını hareket ettirme eylemini açıkça bildirir. Alay, alayın cezası ve şiddetli soğukla ilgili hiçbir öğe bu anlamın parçası değildir; dal tek tanıklığın verdiği dar eylem sınırıyla korunur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız binek hayvanını hareket ettirme eylemidir; genel hareketi, binmeyi veya hayvan sürmeyi kendiliğinden kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız binek hayvanını nesne alan tanıklı eylem biçimine bağlıdır ve her türlü hareket ettirmeye genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir binek hayvanını bulunduğu durumdan çıkarıp hareket ettirmektir; eylem binme, sürme biçimi veya yolculuk sonucu belirtmez.
